title: NovaDeed workflow record
description: NovaDeed workflow record (Novera Protocol Specification v0.1, pre-production). Coordinates ownership, document and workflow state for one transaction or process concerning one asset. NovaDeed does not create, transfer or extinguish legally effective ownership; those effects occur, if at all, in the authoritative external systems and legal processes the workflow references. Every material transition MUST be represented by a NoveraEvent.

workflowId.description: Opaque workflow identifier. MUST NOT be a transaction hash or any other network-specific identifier.

version.description: Record version. Starts at 1 and increases by exactly 1 for each confirmed transition, so version equals the number of transitions.

recordAuthority.description: States that this is a non-authoritative coordination record. It is not a deed, title document or register entry.

workflowType.description: Kind of workflow. Core values are listed; namespaced extension values are permitted.

workflowProfile.description: Optional workflow profile identifier that defines machine-readable authorization, policy and evidence requirements, for example novera-ref:real_estate.purchase.reference. When present, workflowProfileVersion is REQUIRED and implementations MUST resolve the exact profile version.

workflowProfileVersion.description: Exact semantic version of workflowProfile used to authorize this workflow. REQUIRED whenever workflowProfile is present.

participants.description: Participants in the workflow and the roles in which they act.

controlState.description: What the workflow currently records about control and ownership of the asset. A mirror of external facts and workflow intent, not a determination.

workflowState.description: Current workflow state. The core values form the illustrative reference state machine described in primitives/novadeed.md; they are coordination states, not legal categories. Profiles MAY define namespaced states.

policyRefs.description: Policies that apply to the workflow and the results recorded for them.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence associated with the workflow, including documents that make up the transaction package.

transitions.description: Ordered history of confirmed state transitions. Each entry corresponds to exactly one state_transition NoveraEvent. Proposals that were never confirmed do not appear here.

settlementRef.description: Reference to settlement handled through a Settlement Adapter, or null before settlement begins. Novera does not perform settlement; the adapter and the external settlement provider do.

createdAt.description: When the workflow record was created.

updatedAt.description: When the workflow record was last changed.

allOf.description: A workflow that names a profile also pins its exact profile version.
Settlement is authorized before submit: a workflow cannot enter settlement_pending while the adapter is only prepared.

workflowParticipant.description: A participant acting in the workflow.

role.description: Role in the workflow. Core values are listed; profiles MAY define namespaced roles.

status.description: Participation status: invited, active or withdrawn.

joinedAt.description: When the participant joined the workflow.

controlState.description: Control and ownership state as recorded by the workflow.

status.description: Workflow view of control: unchanged (no change agreed), change_proposed, change_agreed_conditionally, change_agreed (conditions met within the workflow), pending_external_registration (awaiting the authoritative system), recorded_externally (the authoritative system reports the change and the report has been reconciled), withdrawn.

recordedControllerRefs.description: Participants that the authoritative source currently records as owners or controllers, as last observed. This mirrors the source; it is not a Novera determination.

proposedControllerRefs.description: Participants proposed to become owners or controllers under the workflow.

basis.description: Basis for recordedControllerRefs: authoritative_reference (taken from an authoritativeRefs entry on the asset), participant_assertion (asserted, not confirmed by a source), unknown.

authoritativeRefKey.description: refKey of the asset authoritativeRefs entry that supports recordedControllerRefs, when basis is authoritative_reference.

observedAt.description: When the authoritative source was last observed.

policyRef.description: A policy that applies to the workflow.

requiredFor.description: Workflow states that MUST NOT be entered unless the latest result for this policy is pass or not_applicable.

resultRefs.description: Policy results recorded for this policy in this workflow, oldest first.

sequence.description: Position in the history, starting at 1 and contiguous.

from.description: State before the transition, or null for the transition that creates the workflow.

eventId.description: The state_transition NoveraEvent that recorded this transition.

settlementRef.description: Reference to settlement through a Settlement Adapter. It is a workflow-state snapshot committed only through normal Novera state transitions; intermediate adapter progress is reported as external_observation events.

adapterId.description: Settlement Adapter instance handling the settlement.

settlementType.description: Kind of settlement the adapter coordinates.

status.description: Adapter-reported lifecycle status: prepared, validated, submitted, observed, reconciled, failed or cancelled. reconciled means the adapter has matched the provider's report to the workflow; it is not a statement of legal finality.

instructionDigest.description: Digest of the settlement instruction produced by prepare().

providerReference.description: Opaque reference assigned by the settlement provider, if any.

externalRefs.description: External records produced by settlement, such as a registration receipt.

networkRefs.description: Network references produced by a network adapter, if settlement involved a network.

updatedAt.description: When the adapter last reported a change.
